t: Flexible, demountable and reusable push-fit system for use with polybutylene, PEX and copper pipes. Suitable for hot and cold water systems in hard and soft water areas, safe for drinking water. No tools required for quick and cost-effective installation. Lightweight design with a maintenance-free white finish. Pipe insert must be used in spigot end of a stem elbow.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
